title: Editorial Decision Entry
description: An append-only status or verification decision recorded without rewriting past fragment, question, or material shards. Later decisions targeting the same record supersede earlier ones in ledger order (respecting explicit supersedes chains) while preserving the full audit trail.

verification_method.description: How a material's primary text was checked when target.type == 'material' (required when status == 'verified'; e.g. PMC open-access full text URL/PMCID, DOI publisher full text, printed edition page check).

verification_depth.description: Depth of the check this overlay carries (2026-11-20). Applied by tools/ledger_io.py onto the material's verification.depth, so a partial read can be recorded as 'results' instead of being forced into verified/partially_verified.

corrected_evidence_record_path.description: Append-only repair of a material's origin.evidence_record_path (2026-11-19). The path is a claim about where the evidence record is; when the claimed file does not exist (a report renamed after the row was written, a shard consolidated away), the shard cannot be rewritten, so the corrected location is carried here and applied by tools/ledger_io.py at load time. Repository-relative, no '..', and the target must be an existing file or an absolute URL — validate_seed.py enforces both and requires that the corrected leaf name differ from the shard's own recorded one.

supersedes.description: Optional IDs of earlier editorial_decisions on the same target that this decision explicitly supersedes, even when older shards carry forward-dated internal chronology prefixes.
